title: A deep copy constructor
description:
`Buffer` owns a heap array. The compiler's automatic copy just copies the **pointer**, so the original and the copy would share one array, and both destructors would try to free it.

Write the copy constructor so that the copy gets its **own** array with the same contents.
hints: In the copy constructor, allocate a new array of `other`'s size (in the member initializer list), then copy each element across.
Never copy the pointer itself: the copy must point at its own array.
